$comment: Every Identity policy decision a foundation-api route asks for (root ADR-0214). Owned by Foundation: it is ROUTE_POLICIES in services/foundation-api/src/routes/mod.rs as data, and routes::tests::route_policies refuses any difference. Identity reads this file: its staff role matrix must grant every staff policy here to some role and grant no foundation.* policy that is not here; its workload policy must give every service policy here to some principal and no foundation.* capability that is not here.
